summary: Iter72: Learned rules (Reglas aprendidas) + CSV export. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (prompt_lines, ai_advisor/fx _build_prompt injection, active() symbol/enabled filtering against real Mongo with unique PrefixedDB prefix, API CRUD on /api/fx/ai-rules incl. uppercased symbol, 409 duplicate, 422 short text, PATCH enabled/text, DELETE ok then 404, isolation from /api and /api/pepper, auth required). UI /hotforex: 'IA ✓' opens analysis, 'Guardar como regla' -> success toast + 'Guardada en reglas' disabled; API shows rule with source_trade_id 6aee77fdfccfc33acf4af24b, verdict EVITABLE. AJUSTES panel: count '1 activas · 1/30', 'Todos los símbolos · de un análisis EVITABLE', toggle off->0 activas/on->1, short text error toast, add XAUUSD rule shows 'Solo XAUUSD', delete removes. /bybit and /pepperstone panels show learned-rules-empty. CSV: historial_hotforex_*.csv, BOM, header and all columns as spec, GBPUSD row EVITABLE;78, note quoted with doubled quotes, tag Revisar, decimal commas (1,3155, -20, -15,2), XAUUSD empty AI columns; filter GBPUSD -> '(1)' and 1 data row; date filter 2030 -> '(0)' disabled. Ver/Analizar regression ok, no console errors on all 3 bots (only an expected 409 resource error, see minor). All rules cleaned up (all three lists empty).

minor.issue: Editing text does not check duplicates (POST returns 409 for same text, PATCH allows creating a duplicate). Duplicate check is case-sensitive.

ui_bugs.issue: After closing and reopening the analysis dialog of a trade whose lesson is already saved, the button shows 'Guardar como regla' enabled again; clicking yields error toast 'Esa regla ya existe' (409, logged as console resource error). Could pre-check existing rules by source_trade_id/text.

issues: Panel body had no padding (content flush with border) — FIXED by tester: added bodyClass='space-y-3 p-4' to Panel in LearnedRulesSection.jsx
